concept.hr: Isto zbrajalo, dva čitanja: prijenos C i preljev V
concept.en: One adder, two readings: the carry C and the overflow V

summary.hr: Zbroji dva broja od 4, 8 ili 16 bitova i gledaj prijenose, kotač brojeva i zastavice N, Z, C, V: prijenos nije preljev.
summary.en: Add two 4-, 8- or 16-bit numbers and watch the carries, the number wheel and the N, Z, C, V flags: a carry is not an overflow.
